universe: Existing codex_three.data.disclosures cached top-100 2024-2025 survey only
economic_rule: An already occurring, adverse operational interruption or impairment whose ongoing exposure explicitly lasts to an identifiable future date 60 through 180 calendar days after the filing. The option term-structure gate is evaluated separately by the parent researcher.
required: Specific actual adverse operational condition, not a hypothetical risk factor or generic forward-looking warning
Explicit stated remaining horizon or dated expected resolution that can be mapped without hindsight to risk_end_date
Risk_end_date 60-180 calendar days after filing date
Full public filing or exhibit confirms the source and horizon
excluded: Ordinary bond maturities or financing dates
Routine projected restructuring completion without ongoing adverse operating impairment
Merger completion or regulatory review schedules
candidate_screen: Review all disclosure excerpts for actual adverse operational terms; search horizons broadly in every row; inspect full filings and exhibits for all plausible operating-risk candidates even if excerpt lacks horizon.
controls: Same adverse operating-risk candidate pool with full-source review but no explicit qualifying horizon; these are nontrigger controls, not an automatically causal matched sample.
